label: Town of Bristol
header:
# Town of Bristol municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 4; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Bristol Selectboard members: Ian Albinson (Chair), Joel Bouvier, John Heffernan, Michelle Perlee, and Jessica Teets (Vice-Chair).

Town of Bristol official website, Selectboard page: lists Ian Albinson (Chair; term to 2028), Jessica Teets (Vice-Chair; term to 2028), Joel Bouvier (term to 2027), John Heffernan (term to 2027), and Michelle Perlee (term to 2029).
Town of Bristol merger charter, Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 108, section 301: town officers are as provided by general law and the Selectboard is fixed at five members.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Sharon Lucia as Town Clerk of Bristol and as Town Treasurer of Bristol.
Town of Bristol, 2026 Annual Meeting Warning (approved January 28, 2026): attested by 'Sharon A. Lucia, Town Clerk'.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Sharon Lucia as Town Clerk of Bristol and as Town Treasurer of Bristol.
Town of Bristol, FY2025 Annual Report, Town Employees page: lists Sharon Lucia as Town Clerk and Town Treasurer.
Town of Bristol official website: the town's official ballot results for the March 3, 2026 annual meeting record Jennifer L. Wagner elected Moderator (549 votes, one-year term).
Town of Bristol, FY2025 Annual Report, Elected Town Officials page: lists Jennifer Wagner as Moderator (term expiring 2026, the seat filled at the 2026 annual meeting).
Town of Bristol official website, town directory: lists Patricia King, Douglas Corkins, and Mark Bouvier as the town's Listers.

Town of Bristol, FY2025 Annual Report, Elected Town Officials page: lists Patricia L. King (term expiring 2026), Douglas Corkins (term expiring 2027), and Mark Bouvier (term expiring 2028) as Listers. The lister seat filled in March 2026 was contested by write-in only and the town published no tally; the town directory continues to list King, and she is recorded from it.

Town of Bristol official website, town directory: styles Sharon Lucia 'Town Clerk/Treasurer/Delinquent Tax Collector'; the town fills the office separately from the treasurer's general duties, so the post is created under 17 V.S.A. section 2651d.

Town of Bristol, FY2025 Annual Report, Elected Town Officials page: lists Bruce Nason as 1st Constable with a term expiring in 2026. The 2026 contest was contested by write-in only and the town published no winner, so the seat is left unfilled rather than carried over. Structure only.
Town of Bristol, FY2025 Annual Report, Elected Town Officials page: the 2nd Constable seat (term expiring 2026) is printed with no name (vacant). Structure only.

Town of Bristol, FY2025 Annual Report, Elected Town Officials page: lists seven Lawrence Memorial Library Trustees: Scott Kluever (term expiring 2026), Daniella Hall Sutherland (term expiring 2026), Peter Hewitt (2027), Elizabeth Guilbeault (2027), Ken Johnson (2028), Darren Kleinfelter (2028), and Vicki Coyle (2028).

Town of Bristol official website: the town's official ballot results for the March 3, 2026 annual meeting record Scott Kluever (469) and Sophie Bristol Pickens (520) elected Library Trustees (three-year terms). Sutherland's term expired in 2026 and she was not re-elected; she is not recorded.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Bristol justices of the peace: Nathan Bouvier, Sharon Compagna, Dayna Epstein, Mark Gibson, Patricia King, Daniel Lyons, Dave Sharpe, Ben Skolozdra, Alicia Standridge, Don Stratton, Anne Wallace, and Helen Young. Nathan Bouvier is a distinct person from Selectboard member Joel Bouvier and Lister Mark Bouvier.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Bristol justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
